evidence.quote: The Petawawa Research Experiment Station was established in 1918 when military authorities asked the Forestry Branch of the federal Department of the Interior to protect and manage the forest of the Petawawa Military Reserve.

evidence.supports: the station pioneered systematic study including fire research
evidence.quote: It pioneered systematic study in silviculture, forest ecology, fire research, and tree breeding and genetics.

evidence.supports: the forest still serves scientific research by the Canadian Forest Service, provinces and industry

notes_for_editor: No build date, height, design, access level or managing agency for Malone appears in any source read; the story says nothing on those. The Firelookout.ca coordinates (45.98166, -77.44848) differ from the brief's point by about 80 m, within the record's precision; no correction proposed. The 'manned' claim comes from an undated independent site, so the story flags it as possibly out of date. Firelookout.ca's Malone record and the Canada Lookouts index agree on the location. The Lost Canada page loaded no text and the Facebook and Instagram snippets were search results only, so neither is used. The Petawawa Research Forest history page does not mention the tower; it is used only for the forest's background.
